title: Paper Trail Ends Here
description: A bulk cancellation isn't finished when the Admin console says "succeeded" — the shipment has to actually die everywhere a customer or dispatcher would look for it. Follow one cancelled shipment from the admin checkbox all the way to the Tracking dashboard.
successCondition: On the Admin console, a test selects an open (not delivered) shipment's checkbox and clicks "Cancel selected", confirming the itemized result shows success:true for that id. The test then navigates to /tracking (same session or a dispatcher/admin session) and confirms the same shipment's row now shows a "cancelled" Badge — without the test itself calling any cancel API directly; the state change must be observed purely through the two UI surfaces.
hints: The tracking page shows the same underlying shipment records the admin bulk panel does — no separate cancelled-shipments view exists.
If the shipment isn't visible on /tracking yet, remember customers only see their own shipments — use a dispatcher or admin account to view it there too.
